name: ADMX SLIC
full_name: Superconducting Lc circuit Investigating Cold axions
summary: An independent ADMX-related low-frequency LC-circuit prototype demonstrating an axion search with a superconducting lumped-element resonator.
detection_principle: A tunable superconducting LC resonator enhances axion-induced current in a magnetic field, with piezoelectric capacitance adjustment scanning frequency.

status.label: The documented historical experimental phase is complete
status.evidence: 2019 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: ADMX SLIC: Results from a Superconducting LC Circuit Investigating Cold Axions

collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

results.summary: Reported coupling exclusions below the 10⁻¹² GeV⁻¹ scale, without claiming axion discovery.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
